Overview

About the Edge & Tower Servers

ASUS edge servers are short-depth 1U systems for telco sites, branch offices and factories, with front or rear access and room for up to three GPU cards for on-site AI inference.

For small offices and branch IT, ASUS tower servers offer an affordable, quiet entry point that does not need a server room.

Short-depth 1U

430 mm deep for space-limited edge locations.

Up to 3 GPUs

PCIe Gen5 x16 slots for edge AI accelerators.

5G and O-RAN ready

Designed for MEC, vRAN and network functions.

Front or rear I/O

-F and -R models for different cabinets.

Tower servers

Entry-level Intel Xeon E towers for SMB and branches.

Specifications

Technical Specifications

EG500-E11 edge server

CPU1× 5th / 4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable, up to 350 W
Memory8 DIMMs, DDR5-5600 / 4800, up to 2 TB
ExpansionUp to 3× PCIe Gen5 x16 (FHHL), up to 3 GPUs
Storage2× 2.5" hot-swap SATA / NVMe, 2× internal 2.5", 2× E1.S, 2× M.2
Networking2× 10G (Intel X710), 1× management
Form factor1U, 430 mm deep
Power650 W or 1300 W redundant Platinum
ManagementASMB11-iKVM, ASUS Control Center (optional)

TS100-E11-PI4 tower server

CPUIntel Xeon E-2300 series, up to 95 W
Memory4 DIMMs, DDR4-3200 ECC UDIMM, up to 128 GB
Expansion4 PCIe slots including 1× Gen4 x16 for graphics
Storage2× 3.5" + 1× 2.5" internal bays, optional cage
Power300 W Bronze or 550 W / 750 W Gold
